title: Bridge the T74 root to the outer dimension and signed format
body:
## Summary

Close PR3477's explicit dimension/format handoff to PR2298 at the retained physical root boundary.

```diff
- fixed d=floor(p^0.997), LSB-first signed root packets
+ explicit encoded d=floor(p^(1/40)) plan, with all dependent reservations
+ MSB-first outer packet -> component reversal -> root -> component reversal
```

The conditional proof checks the changed guard, compact reserve, long-record and cost inequalities. The complete per-component conversions add O(V) tape work and no recursive children or rounding. The exact-K outer bottleneck remains `169711/2000000000000`; no new integer kappa, supplier admission or selected-frontier update is claimed.

Only `research/t74-outer-format-plan/` changes. The executable wrapper uses the actual encoded plan and the retained root's existing injected-plan interface. All 74 runtime source files are byte-authenticated through 36 canonical declared inputs and 38 unchanged retained files, preserving their notices. Pending public comparison heads are exact receipts rather than unavailable publication-ancestry dependencies. Jose Manuel's PR3477/3385/2298, Marius-Paul Dumitrean's PR2979 and the retained compiler/native/physical/numerical lineage retain credit.

## Evidence

- **Before:** the root hard-coded a different dimension law and component bit order, and PR3477 explicitly left these two caller adapters open. **After:** seven actual encoded plans include the two sides of `2^40` and a nonzero-depth T74-divisor case. Four complete physical root calls through the wrapper match a separate rational Walsh oracle, with nonzero spectators and multiple rows/coefficient fields.
- All 508 signed-word packets at widths 2 through 8 preserve values, component order, inverse conversion and borrowed input. Short, long and malformed packets reject cleanly; the joined wrapper rejects an extent error and supports a valid retry. Four optimized actual CLI mutations reject reversed scanning, the old dimension law and omitted entrance/exit adapters.
- Registered Python 3.12 replay, valid optimized scientific execution, four optimized CLI controls and scoped Ruff checks pass at scientific commit `d48b1e0e3d94764edcfbc3dae44810552c14214e`. Both registered commands and valid optimized checks also pass from its Git-free export, with all 91 files unchanged. Publication `c0ee30f63a89c3bd0eabb3ea7eaa7786d5ad707f` only retains two conditional proof premises verbatim and classifies their source/readme records. All 89 prior files other than README/SOURCES are byte-identical. The actual final-head committed-byte/source-history and 93-file export-integrity gates pass. Exact receipts and retained-code deviations are in the package.

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/t74-outer-format-plan
python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/t74-outer-format-plan --check-source-history
```

Use an existing private external TMPDIR. Baseline and submission refresh are canonical main `6f100d4bb5083f8c35d96fd95a539811c62f245c`, priority revision 6, with no relevant delta. [Canonical family/handoff discussion](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2612).

The universal boundary implication is conditional on the retained production native, ordinary, hosting and root-refinement premises. Finite endpoints use a reduced native binding and guard, not O73/GL64 production objects. The actual full outer integration, analytic/error/packing chain and end-to-end multiplier remain open. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed. Lean, Docker, full selected cold replay and hosted CI were not run locally.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** Two-way

An isolated package and explicit adapters; predecessor bytes and existing callers are unchanged.

**Blast Radius:** Package
